faq_heading: Maple Ridge houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Maple Ridge house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 41 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,600,000, with the middle half between $1,400,000 and $1,720,000. Every Maple Ridge detached house had a median of $1,180,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 41 Maple Ridge houses sold with a legal suite and 120 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,226,250.

faq.q: How big can a Maple Ridge suite be?
faq.a: Up to 40% of the gross floor area, one per lot, inside the single detached building, and not in the Floodplain Area, in the zones the City lists.

faq.q: What applies to a Maple Ridge suite on Reserve land?
faq.a: The Commission’s rules allow one secondary suite in the principal residence, and an additional residence only if its conditions are met.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Silver Valley had 16 legal-suite sales, Cottonwood MR 6 and Albion 5 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Maple Ridge houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 41 days at a median, closing at 97.7% of list, with 10% over the list price.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Maple Ridge that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were East Central (75), Albion (71), Silver Valley (64), West Central (57) and Cottonwood MR (52). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 454 detached houses that closed in Maple Ridge between November 1 and August 31, 161 (35%) had a suite: 41 legal and 120 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,600,000, 36% more than the $1,180,000 median for every Maple Ridge house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 5,995 sq ft, against 6,459 sq ft for all Maple Ridge houses. It has 3,654 square feet of floor area, against 2,543. 95% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 41% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,944 square feet and a median $1,226,250.

Alongside suites, 19 Maple Ridge houses had lane access, at a median of $985,000; 4 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge permits one secondary suite per lot in the zones the City lists, A-1, A-2 and A-3 among them. The suite must be inside the single detached building, may take up to 40% of the gross floor area, and is not permitted in the Floodplain Area.

On parcels in the Agricultural Land Reserve, the Agricultural Land Commission’s rules apply as well. They allow one secondary suite in the principal residence and an additional residence only when the Commission’s conditions are met.
A suite in a separate building on acreage is not a secondary suite under these rules, so ask what the listing is describing and which zone the parcel is in.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Maple Ridge was $1,155,900 in September 2026, 7.7% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a Maple Ridge house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Maple Ridge permit and final inspection for the suite. 120 of the 161 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Check the floodplain map for the lot. A suite is not permitted in the Floodplain Area, so a suite in a low-lying house needs the permit history to be clear.
Measure the suite against the limit of 40% of the gross floor area. On the median Maple Ridge legal-suite house of 3,654 square feet, 40% comes to about 1,460 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 41 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,226,250 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,600,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
